svg.title: Common power quality disturbances, sketched on a voltage waveform
svg.desc: Nine small waveform sketches: a normal sine, a sag where a few cycles drop to about half, a swell where they rise, an interruption where they fall to almost zero, an oscillatory transient that rings after a sudden step, harmonic distortion with a flattened repeating shape, flicker where the envelope rises and falls slowly, notching with short dips every half cycle, and three phases of unequal size for unbalance. Dashed lines mark plus and minus nominal peak.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
